title: Yami Kakusei Shite Shujinkou ni Boko Sareru Kamaseinu ni Hyoui Shita ga Gensaku to Chigaisugite Tomadotteru
titleRomaji: Yami Kakusei Shite Shujinkou ni Boko Sareru Kamaseinu ni Hyoui Shita ga Gensaku to Chigaisugite Tomadotteru
titleNative: 闇覚醒して主人公にボコされるかませ犬に憑依したが原作と違いすぎて戸惑ってる
synonyms: I Possessed the Underdog Who Awakens to Darkness and Gets Beaten up by the Protagonist, but I’m Confused Because It’s Too Different from the Original Work
I Reincarnated as a Villainous Noble Fated to Lose, but Got Obsessed with Magic
synopsis: The villainous noble, Zenon Restinatra, is a disappointing "underdog" who gets beaten up by the protagonist in the original anime. "I," a mere fan of the original work, have possessed such a Zenon!? This place is completely the world of the anime, and when I tried out magic for starters, it was super fun. I've decided... I'm going to change Zenon's disappointing ending! The "do-over" life of a magic maniac begins!! (Source: Kodansha, translated)
chapterSourceTitle: Yami Kakusei Shite Shujinkou ni Bokosareru Kamaseinu ni Hyoui Shita ga Gensaku to Chigaisugite Tomadotteru
